listing.name: Guitar Hero III: Legends of Rock — gh3 (sp00nznet)
listing.original_game_title: Guitar Hero III: Legends of Rock
listing.summary: On 2026-09-28, upstream reported a bot completing 45 Easy Quickplay songs at 30–40 FPS. Real guitar controls, timing, career and co-op remain unconfirmed. Follow the setup instructions below. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own USA BLUS30074 disc files, including EBOOT.elf and game assets. The required revision is unspecified; check upstream before preparing files.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Follow upstream instructions to translate the game code again and build with clang-cl, CMake and Ninja.

warnings: On 2026-09-28, upstream reported a bot completing 45 Easy Quickplay songs at 30–40 FPS. Real guitar controls, timing, career and co-op remain unconfirmed.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
